newsitem.title: USA: Duquesne to restart Pa. 833 MW nuke by Fri.
newsitem.headline: Duquesne to restart Pa. 833 MW nuke by Fri.

text.p: Duquesne Light Co said Wednesday it will restart the 833 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the the Beaver Valley nuclear generating station by Friday after the unit tripped off line Monday.

"We expect unit 2 to restart within 48 hours," said company spokesman Dennis O'Neil, adding plant engineers corrected an electrical relay problem in Beaver Valley 2's generator, which led to the shutdown.
The adjacent 810 MW unit 1 was operating at full output, O'Neil said.
Duquesne, a subsidiary of DQE Inc, operates and holds partial stake in both Beaver Valley units in Shippingport, Pa.
Ohio Edison and Centerior Energy are the other owners of the units.
